<?php
class QuietStaticMethodCoalesceTarget { public static function counter() { static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1; return $counter; } }
class QuietStaticMethodCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietStaticMethodCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$held = QuietStaticMethodCoalesceTarget::counter(...);
echo QuietStaticMethodCoalesceTarget::counter() === 1 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietStaticMethodCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietStaticMethodCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === $watch->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;";
echo $answer() === 2 ? "RESULT;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo QuietStaticMethodCoalesceTarget::counter() === 3 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php

class QuietStaticMethodAssignGet {

    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietStaticMethodAssignRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$held = QuietStaticMethodAssignTarget::counter(...);
echo QuietStaticMethodAssignTarget::counter() === 1 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";

$reader = new QuietStaticMethodAssignGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ??= quietStaticMethodAssignRight();
echo $answer === $watch->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;";

echo QuietStaticMethodAssignTarget::counter() === 3 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";
